brief: Djedi: eight characters, seven Legendary and Rare support AR2; a fixed +10% member ATK bonus at two or more members.

champions.name: Kobe Jacoby
champions.title: Warden of the Quiet Mind
champions.lore: Beneath an oversized brown hood, Kobe carries the calm of a thousand silent vigils. His green energy blade moves only when words have failed. Stones lift around him as he turns an enemy’s momentum aside with a thought.
champions.gap: Djedi founding roster: seven Legendaries and Rare support AR2; six attackers, defense Cheeburrash and support AR2. Two or more Djedi members receive +10% ATK.

champions.name: Commander Pain
champions.title: The Fourfold Advance
champions.lore: A scarred metal commander advances beneath a shredded dark cape, four arms drawing a wall of blue and green light. His blades spin until the air screams against them. Every dent upon his chassis records a battle he survived without yielding a step.

champions.name: Jace Gold
champions.title: Keeper of the Sacred Vow
champions.lore: Jace Gold places his faith in discipline, mercy and the sacred duty to protect life. Humble in speech and unwavering in judgment, he carries a purple energy sword as the final answer to cruelty. No borrowed enchantment can stand before his clear resolve.

champions.name: Windwalker
champions.title: Bright Blade of the Rising Path
champions.lore: Windwalker greets impossible odds with a grin and a blue blade already in motion. A single thin braid falls over the front of his shoulder, a reminder that his learning is not finished. His quick feet and fearless heart often reach danger before caution can catch him.

champions.name: Dark Lord
champions.title: Voice Behind the Black Mask
champions.lore: With a scarred, weathered face and gray hair, the Dark Lord speaks with the certainty of an approaching storm. His cape drinks the light of his own crimson blade. Those who meet his gaze feel their strength and resolve begin to falter.

champions.name: Cheeburrash
champions.title: The Roaring Bulwark
champions.lore: Cheeburrash’s guttural roar can carry across a battlefield long after the guns fall silent. Beneath his long brown fur is a loyal heart and a strength few dare test. His crossbow and loaded utility bandolier stand between his companions and anyone foolish enough to pursue them.

champions.name: AR2
champions.title: The Golden-Eyed Improviser
champions.lore: AR2 walks with the uneven rhythm of parts assembled across a hundred workshops. Great golden disc-eyes study every broken circuit and wounded companion. His mismatched hands always seem to find one last spare component when hope is running low.

champions.name: Lord of Darkness
champions.title: The Crimson Aerial Blade
champions.lore: Beneath an oversized black hood, four short horns crown a sinister red face and black-ringed eyes. The Lord of Darkness’s double-ended crimson weapon whirls as he vaults impossibly high, descending with predatory precision. He delights in leaving no safe angle from which to face him.
